note: Routing rules for dispatched workers. No model NAME belongs here: the names come from local/project.json (session.workers.model, session.workers.hard_model, session.main.model), and an empty name means the codex CLI default. Set effort to a literal level (for example ultra) to require it of every dispatch, or leave it empty to accept whatever the caller asks for. dispatch_ratio is the routine:hard band the operator watches; local/bin/model_policy.py reports it, nothing enforces it.
